principles: Track and Milestone are first-class durable entities.

ADR128 rev5: normal Worker handoff is one submit-code; normal submit-tests is not a required Worker contract.
Guide/RUL owns operational sequencing; action descriptions state local action purpose only.

shared_definitions.name: WorkflowRole
shared_definitions.notes: admin is an administrative session role, not a WorkflowRole. Action authorization remains server-enforced and is not duplicated as model-facing per-action schema prose.

shared_definitions.name: EntityKeyAndReference
shared_definitions.owner: entity model validators plus ADR83 naming rule
shared_definitions.notes: Preserve semantic key values and their entity-owned validators. No generic id, *_id, *_key, or parallel identity aliases unless separately owner-approved.

shared_definitions.name: Track
shared_definitions.notes: Track is independently keyed/revisioned and owns its Task membership and review snapshot.

shared_definitions.name: Milestone
shared_definitions.notes: Milestone is independently keyed/revisioned; it owns Task membership and does not embed Track lifecycle state.

shared_definitions.name: Revision

values.semantics: entity revision or explicitly named execution/review revision; not a public hash authority

shared_definitions.notes: CAS and exact revision hashes remain full internal authority.

shared_definitions.name: CursorAndCompactHandle
shared_definitions.owner: ADR84 transport plus ADR100 server-owned handle registry
shared_definitions.failure: Unknown, stale, ambiguous, exhausted, or scope-mismatched handles fail closed. No cursor state is encoded into a public token.

shared_definitions.name: GitFingerprint
shared_definitions.owner: ADR100 publicprojection with Git authority retained by Git/model/service

values.authority: exact full Git object ID internally

shared_definitions.failure: A compact value resolves only against exact authoritative state; unknown, stale, or ambiguous values fail closed.

shared_definitions.name: NonGitDigestOrHandle

values.default: omit if caller does not need it
values.needed_reference: at most 8 ASCII characters, server-owned and resolvable to exact full state

shared_definitions.failure: Never use naive truncation as authority; preserve full SHA-256/CAS/review/verification values internally and fail closed on ambiguity/staleness.

shared_definitions.name: MutationReason
shared_definitions.owner: shared action definition; entity lifecycle validators remain authoritative
shared_definitions.notes: Required where the current mutation contract requires reason; preserve exact action-specific server validation and do not weaken it during schema migration.

shared_definitions.name: Timestamp
shared_definitions.owner: model time.Time fields and shared action definition

values.authority: durable server timestamp; UTC for Task verification proof

shared_definitions.notes: Do not compact or rename timestamp values.

shared_definitions.name: Duration

values.unit: seconds or minutes explicitly named by the action
values.bounds: preserve each action's current minimum, maximum, and default; do not infer one global range

shared_definitions.notes: TSK597 represents duration bounds through the same typed definition model without widening current action limits.

shared_definitions.name: TaskVerification
shared_definitions.public_projection: Only needed compact Git fingerprints and semantic cross-domain references; do not expose unnecessary full non-Git digests.

shared_definitions.name: Operation
shared_definitions.owner: durable local Operation store and operation action service

workflow_contract.planner: Own WHAT/WHY, Task scope, Track composition, and final Track acceptance.
workflow_contract.lead: Own sequential Track execution: dependency/priority eligibility, Worker dispatch and supervision, review, testing/verification, integration, and server-ready Track submission; stop for Planner acceptance.
workflow_contract.worker: Implement the assigned Task, run focused checks, and make one normal submit-code handoff. Normal submit-tests is not mandatory.

schema_cost.method: Marshal each model-facing genericSchemaV2 response as compact JSON and count with internal/tokenizer.Counter using o200k_base. Domain full totals sum the token counts of each separate exact-action response. tools/list counts the six canonical descriptors serialized as JSON.
schema_cost.implication: Compact input-first discovery is materially smaller than expanding every action: task discovery is about 94.7% fewer tokens than its 22 exact contracts combined; Track is about 93.0% fewer than 13; Operation is about 87.7% fewer than 2. Exact action schemas remain available on demand.
